Complete Ligand Activity Prediction Pipeline

Source: R/RcppExports.R
predict_ligand_activities_direct.Rd

Performs the complete ligand activity prediction workflow: gene intersections, matrix subsetting, and metric computation.

Usage

predict_ligand_activities_direct(
  geneset,
  background_genes,
  ligand_target_matrix,
  ligand_names,
  potential_ligands
)

Arguments

geneset

Character vector of target genes

background_genes

Character vector of expressed genes

ligand_target_matrix

Ligand-target matrix (genes x ligands)

ligand_names

All ligand names

potential_ligands

Ligands to evaluate

Value

DataFrame with ligand activity results sorted by aupr_corrected
